thread:
Nina: quick sync
 i'm opening a lightweight docs PR to fix localization copy and add a short 'region availability' FAQ. want a couple reviewers for wording and examples
Omar: +1. can you also include a small note about latency zones vs regions? Support confuses `city` endpoints with residency.
Nina: good call. i'll add a one-line: 'latency zones (city-level endpoints) are for routing; Data Residency controls where data is processed/stored.'
Priya: please show examples for SDK v2 and the CLI. users copy snippets a lot.
Nina: planning two snippets: JS SDK v2 hosted and curl for private deploys. will also show the header and base_url difference. e.g.
```
// hosted (JS SDK v2)
const client = new Redwood({ region: 'eu-berlin-1' });
await client.chat.completions.create(...);
// private (curl)
curl -i -X POST https://private.example.com/v1/chat \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Api-Version: 2026-01-01" \
  -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
Omar: tiny nit
 include `X-Redwood-Region` in the hosted examples too (some integrations rely on it).
Nina: added. also adding a short matrix: `region_code | name | endpoint | residency_supported` to make it copyable.
Legal-bot: draft residency wording reviewed: avoid phrases like "never leaves the region". recommended: "When Data Residency is enabled, data processing occurs within the selected region; control-plane metadata may be routed outside the region unless otherwise configured." Provide link: https://redwood.com/docs/compliance/data-residency
Priya: thanks. can we add a cross-link to the retention policy when we say "retained according to customer settings"? support tickets spike when customers ask about deletion.
Nina: will link retention page. also adding a short migration note for CLI: `redwood region migrate --from us-west-2 --to eu-central-1` (example only, we link to the migration guide).
Omar: one more: show expected http status for region mismatch (400 + helpful message) in the FAQ so users know what to search for.
Nina: good idea. adding example error snippet and short troubleshooting steps.
Docs-bot: PR created #2410 by Nina: docs/region-localization-faq
 reviewers requested: Omar, Priya
Omar: reviewing now
 left one inline about capitalization of "Data Residency" (make it title case).
Priya: LGTM with legal wording in place. will hit approve after tiny formatting tweak.
Nina: fixed caps and formatting. merging on green. can someone sanity-check the quickstart in staging after the preview publishes?
Omar: i'll run the JS snippet in staging tonight and paste the output here.
Nina: thanks y'all! :heart:
